title: Practical Typography
notes: I enjoyed this book. A must read for UX designers in my opinion. It's my goto reference for anything related to typography.

title: No Longer Human
notes: This is probably one of the most depressing short fiction books I have ever read in my life. I highly recommend it.

title: Metamorphosis
notes: I know people take this book seriously, but I couldn't help but laugh throughout the entire book because of how ridiculous the concept is.

title: Rabid
notes: Fairly interesting book about rabies and its origins. Who would have thought that the idea of zombies and vampires originated from rabies... I suppose it's pretty obvious.

title: The Midnight Library
notes: This book is a bit of a mindfuck. Ultimately, it can be summed up that you shouldn't take your current life for granted.

title: How You Say It
notes: This book introduces the hypothesis that accents can influence how people form biases about you with evidence-backed studies.
